limitations: The fixed matrix must be nilpotent, the moving matrix must be nonzero rank-one and square-zero, and the dimension is at least three; full pair-orbit counts are not obtained. Older Guralnick and Neubauer papers were available in abstract only.
scientific_integrity: The result is established by a self-contained general proof with finite-field cross-checks. Finite tests are not used as infinite proofs. Claims of full historical priority and independent certification are not made.
title: First-two-nullity control of rank-one nilpotent commutator spectra
